fail_fact.title: OT Networks must be protected
text: On Sept 29th 2025, Asahi Breweries in Japan stated they have logistical issues due a ransomware attack. It proved to be a disaster, challenging product delivery for over a month.
Every enterprise should design with care its OT networks, and make all the steps necessary to ensure full business continuity in events like this.
How are your processes? When did you call your consultant for TVA or BIA?
